Where confidence grows. 💙 📚 Years 10–13 Specialist School 🌍 Looking Forward • Looking Outward • Taking Action 👇 Discover what makes Logic different
Find out more
Answers to what families ask us most about joining Logic Studio School.
About
What is Logic Studio School?
Logic is a 14-19 Studio School that bridges the gap between education and employment by treating students as “young adults” and “trainee professionals” in a business-like environment.
What are the school values?
It is our core ethos centered on three pillars: Looking Forwards (future goals), Looking Outwards (understanding society), and Taking Action (personal responsibility).
How does Logic support student well-being?
Every student has access to a dedicated 1-to-1 coaching programme designed to support academic progress, mental health, and future planning.
How do I get to Logic?
Situated just 10 minutes from Feltham train station the school is served by many local bus routes. There is ample parking on site which students can make use of (once they have gained their license of course).
Curriculum & Specialism
What subjects does Logic specialise in?
We offer a broad curriculum with a heavy focus on Business, Computing, Creative Digital Media, Social Sciences and Humanities.
What are 'Personal Development Weeks'?
Every half-term, students step away from standard lessons to engage in industry visits, work experience, and projects that build core skills like leadership and collaboration.
What qualifications does Logic offer?
Our pathways include GCSE, A-Levels, T-Levels, V-Levels and BTEC qualifications, alongside industry standard qualifications through our own unique Employer Engagement pathway.
How does Logic support students with SEND?
Every child deserves the very best education. Our dedicated staff know our students as individuals and work tirelessly to ensure they are supported to achieve.
Our Personal Coaching team work with our SENDco and teaching staff providing high quality, common sense, support.
More information can be found on our SEND page.
What are the average class sizes?
We pride ourselves on our small, bespoke approach. In Year 10 and 11 classes are typically 24. Our day starts with Prep in which students are in classes of 16.
In Year 12 and 13 the class size is dependent on the interest in any given year. A-levels typically run between 10 and 20 students with Btec courses slightly larger.
Where do students go after Logic?
Students starting with us in Year 10 tend to say on to our Sixth Form and indeed are typically our highest attaining students.
Year 13 are tracked to successful onward destinations including Russell group universities, degree apprenticeships, direct employment, or other meaningful routes to work. We have Alumni at most major universities across the UK including London School of Economics, Imperial and Kings College London.
Application
Can I change school in Year 10?
Yes. While most schools only accept students at Year 7, Logic Studio School is a Studio School specifically designed for students to start a fresh, career-focused education in Year 10 or Year 12. Our small school offers a professional alternative to traditional secondary schools in Hounslow.
There are no entry requirements. If you think we are the right next step for you we would love to hear from you.
Can I come and visit the school?
Yes! In fact, we think this is the most important part. It sounds cliche but seeing is believing. We want you to feel comfortable you are making the right decision. When you start an application you will be sent an email with a booking link so that you can find a time that works for you.
Our Open Evening event is held in November each year. We would encourage all interested to attend this event.
How do I apply?
We handle all applications through our website. There is a bright pink button in the corner of your screen. Give it a click and come and see us!
Is there an application deadline?
Officially our application deadline for Year 10 is the October in the year before you would start in September. In reality, we continue to accept applications until we are full, at which point we start a waiting list.
There is no application deadline for Year 12, though we allocate courses on a ‘first come, first served’ basis, so don’t delay your application.
I have completed an application, what happens next?
Firstly, thank you! We will be in touch shortly to arrange a tour and a chat with the Principal. Following this you will be given access to our online admissions system. If you think we are the right next step simply add your information and we will send an official offer.
What are the entry requirements for Logic Studio School Sixth Form?
To join our Sixth Form in Feltham, students typically need a minimum of 6 GCSEs at grade 4 or above (including English and Maths) for BTEC Level 3 courses. For A-Level pathways, we look for grades 6-9 in relevant subjects. We welcome external applicants from across West London and Surrey and always look to support students to join us.
What is a Studio School and how is it different from a normal school?
A Studio School is a professional, small-scale academy (max 330 students) that focuses on “learning by doing.” Unlike a standard school, Logic Studio School partners with industry leaders to deliver project-based learning. We offer the same GCSEs and A-Levels as other schools but in a workplace-style environment.
Is there a catchment area for Logic Studio School?
We do not have a strict catchment area. We accept students from Feltham, Hounslow, Ashford, Staines, Richmond, and Twickenham. As long as you can commute to our campus in West London, you are eligible to apply for Year 10 or Year 12.
How much does it cost to study at Logic Studio School?
There are no fees, Logic is a publicly funded school.
Open Evening Y10&12
Thursday 26th November 5:30-7pm
Seeing is believing, but hearing from our community will tell you everything you need to know about the difference we make everyday.

Sometimes education just doesn’t make sense. Employers are saying that the system simply isn’t producing young people suited to the modern economy. Universities tell us that undergraduates are unprepared for independent study. Something is missing.
The whole concept of Logic has been developed with this and the local community in mind. We want to link the education that you receive with the careers available to you in the local economy and beyond. We want to help you access a better future with outstanding progression routes into university, employment or further training.
Alex Pett – Principal
“I have a strong commitment to the local community having worked at this site since 2009 when I was appointed as a maths teacher. I have held various leadership roles over the years working as Vice Principal at Springwest Academy and Director of Teaching and Learning for Tudor Park Education Trust.
I have worked at Logic since its opening teaching both Computer Science and A-Level Mathematics. I am proud to have been a part of its development to this point and am excited to continue pushing Logic to be at the forefront of innovative education.
The ethos of looking forward, looking outward, taking action, really is at the very heart of everything we do as a school. I promise that our education will inspire and that our students will leave with skills that make them highly sought after and adept at working in modern society. ”
Contact – a.pett@logicstudioschool.org
Steve Price – CEO Tudor Park Education Trust
“I am honoured and delighted to be the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Tudor Park Education Trust, of which Logic Studio School is one of its founding members. It is with great enthusiasm that I to serve our schools and their communities. After nearly thirty years of working in schools across London, I truly believe that great schools give students better life chances and I relish the opportunity to work with you as parents, students and school staff. I know that a great education gives life changing opportunities to young people and each and every one of our students deserves the best.
Looking to the future and to ensure that we are always ahead of the game in providing the best, the idea of a small specialist Business and Creative Media school, working in partnership with local business partners, appeared to be too much of an opportunity not to grab with both hands for our students. Hence Logic was born and sits inside our Trust- Tudor Park Education Trust.
It has been incredibly exciting watching Logic grow into a thriving busy hub of learning and experience. I know our business partners are just as thrilled to be helping young people develop a clear and certain future. ”
Contact – s.price@tudorparkeducationtrust.org

Logic Studio School
Welcome one and all to another academic year here at Logic Studio School. It has been another record-breaking summer of results and achievements (which you can read more about below) and a busy return. We are celebrating record numbers in our Sixth Form for the second year in a row, with over 130 students now joining us.
What is really pleasing to me is hearing the reasons students are choosing us. As expected, there are lots of comments around the student experience and quality of teaching. Perhaps more surprising is the number who now cite the fact that they want to come to Logic because they know they will get the support needed to achieve a good final destination.
I have spoken to students and parents about our vision:
“To shape happy, ambitious, and digitally fluent young people who possess the emotional intelligence and resilience to thrive in tomorrow’s world.”
This is something you, as parents, can hold us accountable for.
Please take the time to check through the information in the rest of this email; we have important parents’ events coming up for students in Years 11, 12, and 13. There is also information below for parents who have previously been in receipt of free school meals.
At the bottom of this email are the key contacts you may need as a parent. Please do not hesitate to get in touch if you feel there is something we can support with.
I will finish with our ethos: Looking forward to another great year Looking outward to an ever-changing world Taking action to ensure your child is ready for what comes next

pageCache.pageTitle: GCSE Results show Benchmark-Beating Performance in Maths and Creative Media | Logic Studio School
pageCache.text:
Students and staff at Logic Studio School are celebrating a strong set of Key Stage 4 GCSE results. The headline achievements are led by exceptional gains in Mathematics and standout results in Creative Media, alongside significant individual progress made across the Year 11 cohort.
In Mathematics, student performance demonstrated impressive progression from mock examinations, with final results coming directly in line with the top 20% of schools nationally. In total, 54.8% of students secured a Grade 4 or higher in Maths, while 31% achieved a Grade 5 or above.
Alongside success in core numerical skills, students achieved outstanding results in Creative Media, underscoring Logic Studio School’s core commitment to practical, industry-focused qualifications. English performance also made substantial progress from mock baselines, finishing in line with the top 50% of schools nationally, with 40% of students achieving Grade 4+ and 26.2% earning Grade 5+.
Across the final cohort of 42 Year 11 students, 36% achieved a Grade 4 or higher in both English and Maths, with 21% reaching Grade 5 or above in both core subjects.
Recognising Outstanding Attainment and Value-Added Progress
The results celebrate high academic attainment while highlighting the remarkable progress made by students from their initial targets:
Individual Performance
We are delighted to celebrate a number of really strong individual performances. Anthony achieved Grade 9 in Maths, Grade 8 in Computer Science & Literature, and Grade 7 in English Language. Arlo secured Grade 8 in Business Studies & English Language, plus Grade 7s in Maths & Computer Science. Krishnavi earned Grade 7s across Maths, English Language, and English Literature.
Progress from mock exams should also be celebrated with Omer gaining almost 2 grades on average across the board. Rishta also saw a considerable increase by almost 1.5 grades.
Leadership Commentary
“We are tremendously proud of our Year 11 students for their dedication and hard work,” said the Principal, Alex Pett. “Seeing our Mathematics results perform in line with the top 20% of schools nationally is really pleasing. Coupled with the excellent results in Creative Media and the inspiring progress made across all subjects, these outcomes set a strong foundation for our students’ future in both technical and academic pathways.”
